mapper.sql: select effectiveness_id, capa_id, capa_no, check_period, check_date, checker, check_method, check_result, evidence, recurrence_flag, recurrence_desc, action_taken, esig_user, esig_time, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from qms_capa_effectiveness
mapper.select: where capa_id = #{capaId} and del_flag = '0' order by check_date desc
mapper.insert: insert into qms_capa_effectiveness(capa_id, capa_no, check_period, check_date, checker, check_method, check_result, evidence, recurrence_flag, recurrence_desc, action_taken, esig_user, esig_time, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{capaId}, #{capaNo}, #{checkPeriod}, #{checkDate}, #{checker}, #{checkMethod}, #{checkResult}, #{evidence}, #{recurrenceFlag}, #{recurrenceDesc}, #{actionTaken}, #{esigUser}, sysdate(), #{status}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: update qms_capa_effectiveness set del_flag = '1' where effectiveness_id in #{id}
